$comment: Caldova Logistikzentrum — the fictional wholesaler in the REAL Confex building at Koelnmesse (opened 2024). Geobasis NRW, so the Campus-Scheduler NRW adapters (fetch_nrw.py, fetch_dop20_nrw.py) apply. The use of the building is fictional and badged; the building, terrain, imagery and roads are measured.
$lensesComment: Empty until the generators behind a lens exist (engine lesson: never declare a lens before its data).

bbox.$comment: HIGH-RESOLUTION CORE, ~3.16 x 3.00 km: Koelnmesse with the Confex (OSM way/888175931, centre 50.94413 / 6.97471), Deutz, the Rhine with Hohenzollern- and Deutzer Brücke, and the Altstadt with the Dom. Phase 1 replaces the LoD2 + DOP core by the NRW 3D-Mesh over this same box.

shell.$comment: COARSE TERRAIN SHELL, ~13.3 x 11.7 km, about 6 km around the Confex. Kept south of 51 N so only two Copernicus tiles are needed. The LoD2 + DOP10 delivery ring inside this shell arrives with the tours in Phase 3.

elevationRangeM.$comment: PROVISIONAL. The Uni-Köln AOI measured 40.42-65.21 m on DGM1; the Rhine bank at Deutz sits lower (~36-45 m). Replace with the measured min/max after build_terrain.py runs.

drape.$comment: DOP via the Geobasis NRW WMS (layer nw_dop_rgb, 10 cm source). 4096 px over 3.16 km = ~0.77 m/px. NOT larger: at 8192 px Chromium silently samples black (Campus-Scheduler lesson).

shellGrids.$comment: Copernicus GLO-30. transitionBandM is applied as a fraction of the core (CORE_FADE_FRACTION), never absolute — inherited from the Köln campus AOI.

$focusPlacesComment: Every coordinate was resolved from OSM on 2026-10-17. The Dom, Hohenzollernbrücke and Deutzer Brücke are added once resolved, never typed from memory.

geobasis.$comment: pipeline.py's in_nordrhein_westfalen keys on 'Geobasis NRW' in `authority` — load-bearing. The 3D-Mesh licence is verified separately in Phase 0.

shellGeobasis.authority: ESA / DLR / Airbus Defence and Space — Copernicus DEM GLO-30

site3d.$comment: ⚠️ THE INTERIOR IS SYNTHETIC AND BADGED. Caldova is fictional; the Confex is a real congress and exhibition building of Koelnmesse (opened 2024). Its footprint is measured (OSM way/888175931) and its height comes from the NRW nDOM50 / 3D-Mesh; the zone layout, machines, volumes and tours are a seeded model of a pharma wholesaler, not a statement about the building or its owner.

shiftPattern.$comment: Industry shape (2-3 deliveries per pharmacy per day, the first before opening). Times invented. v1 has no night scene, so the first wave leaves at 05:30 and the app opens at 09:00 in daylight.

pharmacies.$comment: ~120 fictional pharmacies at real OSM pharmacy coordinates within ~6 km. Only coordinates are taken; names are fictional.

vehicles.$comment: The tours with the most order lines (top third) run a 7.5 t truck, the rest a Sprinter-size van.
